# OpenBridge widget reference

<!-- Generated by tools/openbridge/make-widgets.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Grid: **24 px**. OpenBridge: **1.0.0**. Placement: `left = node.x × 24 − anchor.x`, `top = node.y × 24 − anchor.y` (see [openbridge.md](openbridge.md)).

| Widget | Element | Box (px) | Anchor (px) | Anchor meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ob-pump` | `obc-pump` | 120×120 | (48, 48) | centre of the icon |
| `ob-motor` | `obc-motor` | 120×120 | (48, 48) | centre of the icon |
| `ob-fan` | `obc-fan` | 120×120 | (48, 48) | centre of the icon |
| `ob-valve-digital` | `obc-digital-valve` | 120×120 | (48, 48) | centre of the icon |
| `ob-valve-analog` | `obc-analog-valve` | 120×120 | (48, 48) | centre of the icon |
| `ob-tank` | `obc-automation-tank` | 192×216 | (96, 24) | top-centre of the tank body |
| `ob-readout` | `obc-automation-readout` | 192×120 | (96, 48) | end of the connection tick |
| `ob-line-horizontal` | `obc-horizontal-line` | 96×48 (stretches in X) | (0, 24) | start of the pipe axis (left) |
| `ob-line-vertical` | `obc-vertical-line` | 48×96 (stretches in Y) | (24, 0) | start of the pipe axis (top) |
| `ob-line-elbow` | `obc-corner-line` | 48×48 | (24, 24) | centre of the fitting |
| `ob-line-tee` | `obc-three-way-line` | 48×48 | (24, 24) | centre of the fitting |
| `ob-line-cross` | `obc-line-cross` | 48×48 | (24, 24) | centre of the fitting |
| `ob-line-overlap` | `obc-line-overlap` | 48×48 | (24, 24) | centre of the fitting |
| `ob-line-end` | `obc-end-point-line` | 48×48 | (24, 24) | centre of the fitting |
| `ob-line-flow` | `obc-direction-line` | 24×48 | (0, 24) | start of the pipe axis (left) |

## Pump — `ob-pump`

OpenBridge element `obc-pump`, file `server/_widgets/openbridge/ob-pump.svg`.

| Property | Type | Default | Dir | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `_pb_running` | bool | `false` | read | Running feedback |
| `_pn_speed` | num | `0` | read | Speed % (readout) |
| `_pb_vertical` | bool | `false` | read | Vertical orientation (pipe runs top-bottom) |
| `_ps_labelDirection` | str | `down` | read | Readout side: up | down | left | right |
| `_pb_alarm` | bool | `false` | read | Alarm active (alert frame) |
| `_pb_auto` | bool | `false` | read | Badge: automatic mode |
| `_pb_locked` | bool | `false` | read | Badge: command locked |
| `_pb_duty` | bool | `false` | read | Badge: duty unit |
| `_pb_alarmOff` | bool | `false` | read | Badge: alarms suppressed |
| `_ps_tag` | str | `—` | read | Numeric equipment ID shown as #NNNN, e.g. 101 (empty = hidden) |
| `_pb_command` | bool | `false` | write | Start/stop command, written on click as !running (1/0) |
